issue.title: Replace Launch checklist with a compact shadcn data table
issue.description:
Replace the current "Launch checklist" gallery composition with a compact data-table composition based on shadcn's Data Table pattern.

Reference:

* Use the current shadcn Data Table component/pattern as the implementation reference:
  [https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/data-table](<https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/data-table>)

Owner direction:

* Remove the existing Launch checklist composition from the Cards gallery.
* Replace it in the same general gallery slot with a compact data table.
* The table itself should be the composition; do not include the surrounding table-management UI from the full shadcn example.

Include:

* row selection checkbox column if it fits naturally;
* Status column;
* Email column;
* Amount column;
* row action / ellipsis menu if useful;
* a small realistic set of example rows;
* clear table borders/dividers using semantic tokens;
* responsive containment appropriate for the gallery.

Do not include:

* table title/header above the table;
* filter/search input;
* Columns select/menu;
* "0 of 5 row(s) selected" or equivalent selection summary;
* Previous / Next pagination controls;
* other toolbar/footer controls from the full shadcn example.

Visual intent:

* clean, compact, polished table composition;
* the table should feel complete on its own inside the gallery card;
* avoid unnecessary surrounding chrome;
* preserve stable composition height.

Implementation constraints:

* Prefer the existing shadcn Table/Data Table architecture and primitives.
* Use TanStack Table only if already required by the current shadcn implementation or clearly warranted by the accepted project architecture.
* Do not add unrelated dependencies or a generic data-grid system solely for this gallery example.
* Keep styling driven by Personal UI semantic tokens.
* Preserve Heading / Body / Mono typography roles where relevant.
* Keep light/dark mode coherent.
* Avoid arbitrary raw colors when semantic tokens exist.
* Do not expand the public resource registry unless the table primitive/resource is already part of accepted architecture or a genuinely reusable addition is justified.

Interaction:

* Simple row selection and row-action affordances may remain functional.
* Do not add pagination/filtering workflows.
* Interaction should not materially change card height or overall geometry.

Gallery/layout:

* Preserve the accepted container-responsive Cards gallery architecture.
* Keep the replacement in the intended Launch checklist position unless another admitted ticket explicitly changes ordering.
* Preserve coherent DOM/focus order and responsive behavior.
* No masonry, dense packing, or global row-coupling changes.

Acceptance:

* Launch checklist no longer appears in the Cards gallery.
* A compact data table replaces it in the intended gallery slot.
* The composition contains only the table surface, without filter, Columns selector, selection-summary footer, or pagination controls.
* Table includes Status, Email, and Amount columns, with optional row selection/actions as appropriate.
* Styling remains driven by Personal UI semantic tokens.
* Light/dark rendering is coherent.
* Interaction remains lightweight and geometry-stable.
* No overflow, focus-order, keyboard, accessibility, or responsive regression.
* No unnecessary public component/resource expansion is introduced.
